item.title: Jung: "One-homeowner without income gets temporary property tax cut" … Oh: "Small business policy loans total 3 trillion won" (정 “소득없는 1주택자 재산세 한시 감면”…오 “소상공인 정책자금 융자 3조”)
item.description:
In the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor, Democratic Party of Korea candidate Jung Won-oh and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon each unveiled pledges on real estate and small businesses on the 13th, vying for voter support. (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에 나선 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 13일 각각 부동산과 소상공인 공약을 발표하며 표심 잡기에 나섰다.)

Candidate Jung held a press conference at the National Assembly on this day, announcing a pledge to "temporarily reduce the property tax for retired single-homeowners without income." Jung said, "We will push for a measure to temporarily reduce the increased portion of property tax this year due to rising public prices, targeting citizens who are single-homeowners, above a certain age, and without business or earned income." Jung added that he would specify the target group by referencing factors such as financial income, rental income status, and the current comprehensive real estate tax senior deduction criteria (age 60). He stated, "We will ensure that the reduction for this year's increase is reflected in the property tax levied in September, while also considering a plan to handle the July portion through a refund method." Under the Local Tax Special Restriction Act, local governments can temporarily reduce property taxes through ordinances. (정 후보는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “소득 없는 은퇴 1주택자의 재산세를 한시적으로 감면하겠다”는 내용의 공약을 발표했다. 정 후보는 “1주택자 중 일정 연령 이상이면서 사업소득과 근로소득이 없는 시민을 대상으로 공시가격 상승으로 올해 늘어난 재산세 증가분을 한시적으로 감면하는 조치를 추진하겠다”고 말했다. 정 후보는 금융소득·임대소득 여부와 현행 종합부동산세 고령자 세액공제 기준(만 60살) 등을 참고해 감면 대상을 구체화하겠다고 했다. 그는 “오는 9월 부과되는 재산세에 올해 증가분 감면이 반영될 수 있도록 하되, 7월분은 환급 방식으로 처리하는 방안도 검토하겠다”고 했다. 지방세특례제한법상 지방자치단체는 조례를 통해 재산세를 한시적으로 감면할 수 있다.)

Candidate Oh Se-hoon, at his election office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, announced, "Small business owners are experiencing tremendous difficulties following the Middle East war," and "We will expand the total loan limit for small business policy funds to 3 trillion won and lower the effective interest rate by 0.2 percentage points." He said he would increase the total limit of the 'Safe Account' for self-employed individuals from the current 400 billion won to 500 billion won, and expand support for industries struggling due to high oil prices and exchange rates following the Middle East war from 100 billion won to 400 billion won. <<> Amidst this, Rep. Kim Jae-seop of the People Power Party, co-chair of the Oh Se-hoon campaign, stated, "In 1995, candidate Jung was at a drinking party where he forced a café owner to arrange an overnight stay with a female employee, threatened the owner who refused, and assaulted both a citizen who intervened and the dispatched police officer," adding, "Candidate Jung has explained this (assault record) as a fight arising from differing views on the May 18 Democratization Movement, but that is a lie." <<> In response, Jung's camp released the court ruling from the time, stating, "While discussing politics with a Democratic Liberal Party lawmaker, voices were raised due to differing political affiliations, leading to an altercation," and countered, calling it "malicious black propaganda." The Democratic Party has decided to file a complaint against Rep. Kim. <<> Reported by Kim Chae-un, cwk@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae, young@hani.co.kr (오세훈 후보는 서울 종로구 선거사무소에서 “소상공인들이 중동 전쟁 이후 굉장한 어려움을 겪고 있다”며 “소상공인 정책자금 총융자 규모를 3조원으로 늘리고, 실부담 금리도 0.2%포인트 낮추겠다”고 발표했다. 그는 자영업자 ‘안심통장’ 총한도를 기존 4천억원에서 5천억원까지 늘리고, 중동 전쟁에 따른 고유가·고환율로 어려움을 겪는 업종에 대한 지원도 1천억원에서 4천억원으로 늘리겠다고 했다.)

item.title: 47.9% say prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers "should be retained," 37.7% say "should be abolished" (검찰 보완수사권 “남겨둬야” 47.9% “폐지해야’ 37.7%)
item.description:
As the government and ruling party plan to discuss whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers after the June 3 local elections, nearly half of voters expressed the opinion that these powers should be retained. (정부·여당이 6·3 지방선거 뒤 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 본격적으로 논의할 예정인 가운데, 유권자의 절반 가까이가 ‘보완수사권을 유지해야 한다’는 의견을 보였다.)

According to the results of the fourth voter panel survey released on the 13th, in response to the question, "Should the supplementary investigation powers, which allow prosecutors to independently reinvestigate cases sent by the police, be completely abolished or partially retained?" 47.9% of respondents said "the prosecution's supplementary investigation function should be retained" (partial retention, oppose abolition). The response that supplementary investigation powers should be completely abolished was 37.7%. In detail, 19.8% said they should be "completely abolished and only the right to request supplementary investigation should be granted," while 17.9% said they should be "completely abolished and the right to request supplementary investigation should also be stripped." Another 14.3% of respondents said they "did not know." (13일 4차 유권자 패널 조사 결과를 보면 ‘경찰이 송치한 사건에 대해 검찰이 직접 다시 수사할 수 있는 보완수사권을 100% 없앨 것이냐, 일부 남겨둘 것이냐’는 질문에 ‘검찰의 보완수사 기능은 남겨두어야 한다’(일부 존치, 폐지 반대)는 응답이 47.9%로 집계됐다. 보완수사권을 완전 폐지해야 한다는 응답은 37.7%였다. 세부적으로 보면 ‘완전 폐지하고 보완수사 요구권만 부여해야 한다’는 응답은 19.8%였고 ‘완전 폐지하고 보완수사 요구권도 박탈해야 한다’는 응답은 17.9%였다. 응답자의 14.3%는 ‘잘 모르겠다’고 했다.)

Responses regarding supplementary investigation powers varied by political orientation. Among those who identified as progressive, 64.4% said the powers should be abolished. Among centrists, 46.4% said the powers should be retained, while 35.3% said they should be abolished. Among conservatives, 77.6% said the supplementary investigation function should be retained. (보완수사권에 대한 응답은 정치 성향에 따라 엇갈렸다. 자신을 진보층이라고 응답한 이들 중 64.4%가 보완수사권을 폐지해야 한다고 답했다. 중도층은 46.4%가 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다고 응답했고, 35.3%는 보완수사권을 폐지해야 한다고 했다. 보수층은 77.6%가 보완수사 기능을 유지해야 한다고 답했다.)

This panel survey also asked about the special counsel bill that grants the special counsel the authority to drop charges, known as the "fabricated indictment special counsel bill." In response to the question, "Regarding the special counsel bill proposed by the Democratic Party, the People Power Party argues that granting the special counsel authority to drop charges is unconstitutional, while the Democratic Party counters that it is only natural for the special counsel to decide whether to maintain the indictment. Which opinion do you agree with more?" 51.6% supported the special counsel bill, while 31.5% opposed it. (이번 패널 조사에서는 특검에 공소취소 권한을 부여한 조작기소 특검법안에 대해서도 물었다. ‘민주당이 발의한 특검법안에 대해 국민의힘은 특검에 공소취소 권한을 부여한 것은 위헌 법률이라고 주장하고, 민주당은 특검이 공소 유지 여부를 판단하는 것은 당연하다고 반박하는데 어떤 의견에 더 동의하느냐’는 물음에 특검법안에 찬성한다는 응답은 51.6%, 반대한다는 응답은 31.5%로 나타났다.)

<Survey Method and Overview> (<조사방법 및 개요>)

2025-2026 Voter Panel Survey (4th) (2025~2026 유권자 패널조사(4차))

Commissioned by: The Hankyoreh, Korean Political Science Association (조사의뢰: 한겨레·한국정당학회)

Survey Agency: STI Co., Ltd. (조사기관: (주)에스티아이)

Survey Period: May 6-10, 2026 (조사일시: 2026년 5월 6~10일)

Survey Target: 1,701 nationwide voters (조사대상: 전국 유권자 1701명)

Survey Method: Mobile web survey using smartphones (99.6%) combined with wired and wireless telephone interviews (wireless 0.3%, wired 0.1%) (조사방법: 휴대전화를 이용한 모바일 웹조사(99.6%)와 유무선 전화면접조사(무선 0.3%, 유선 0.1%) 병행)

Selection Method for Respondents: Panel built by the survey agency (among 4,864 recruited using wired/wireless RDD and telecom subscriber panels, 2,020 panelists from the 3rd survey were included) (피조사자 선정방법: 조사기관 구축 패널(유무선 RDD 및 통신사 가입자 패널 활용 모집 4864명 중 3차조사 참여 패널 2020명))

Response Rate: 88.3% (1,701 responded out of 1,926 contacted) (응답률: 88.3%(1,926명 접촉 중 1,701명 응답))

Sampling Error: ±2.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (표본오차: 95% 신뢰수준에서 ±2.4%포인트, 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "U.S. Also Agrees to Wartime Operational Control Transition"... Differing Views on Achievement Timeline (안규백 “미국도 전작권 전환 동의”…달성 시점엔 이견)
item.description:
Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek stated on the 12th (local time) that while the United States fully agrees to a conditions-based transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON), "there are parts where the U.S. side has somewhat different thoughts." Regarding the normalization of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, he conveyed to the U.S. that a phased contribution plan would be reviewed. (안규백 국방부 장관이 12일(현지시각) 미국이 조건에 기초한 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환에 전적으로 동의했지만, “미측에서 약간의 다른 생각을 가진 부분이 있다”고 말했다. 호르무즈해협 통항 정상화와 관련해선 단계적으로 기여하는 방안을 검토하겠다는 입장을 미국에 전달했다.)

During a briefing with special correspondents at the South Korean embassy in Washington that day, Minister Ahn explained his meeting with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth the previous day, saying, "From our standpoint, there is not a shred of wavering in the early return of OPCON. Secretary Hegseth said he fully agrees to a conditions-based OPCON transition and hopes it will be transferred as soon as possible accordingly." However, he added, "There are parts where the U.S. side has somewhat different thoughts." While the South Korean government aims for OPCON transfer by 2028 or earlier, before the end of both countries' presidential terms, U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson has set the target timeline for achieving OPCON transfer as 'before the first quarter of 2029.' <<> Regarding the recovery of OPCON, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac also emphasized at a newspaper and broadcasting editors' association meeting at the Press Center in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the 13th, "The South Korean military is securing capabilities through increased defense spending to play a leading role in the defense of the Korean Peninsula, and we are also pushing to complete the OPCON recovery roadmap and the Full Operational Capability (FOC) verification this year." South Korea and the U.S. are currently proceeding with a three-stage verification process under the Conditions-based OPCON Transition Plan (COTP), aiming to complete the second stage, FOC verification, within this year. <<> In this context, Commander Brunson, in a keynote speech at the Association of the U.S. Army's Indo-Pacific Ground Forces Symposium held in Hawaii on the same day, responded to a question about 'what keeps you up at night' by saying, "The possibility of us trying to push things that require accumulated expertise according to a schedule is what keeps me up." This is interpreted as an expression of dissatisfaction with the differing views between South Korean and U.S. military authorities regarding the OPCON transition timeline. <<> Director Wi and Minister Ahn both indicated their intention to align with the international community regarding the normalization of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. <<> Director Wi Sung-lac stated, "We are reviewing the U.S. Freedom of Navigation initiative." When asked, "To what extent can South Korea participate militarily in the process of joining international efforts?" he replied, "It hasn't been decided, but there could be a military role at various stages. We are currently thinking about what we can do." Minister Ahn also said regarding his meeting with Secretary Hegseth, "We went as far as saying that we would comprehensively consider and review contribution plans moving forward, while applying international and domestic legal procedures." The phased contribution mentioned by Minister Ahn follows the order: statement of support → personnel dispatch → information sharing → military asset support. <<> Meanwhile, the Presidential Office stated that it has no basis to conclude that the cause of the fire on the HMM NAMUHO was a 'drone.' Director Wi said, "The reason for not specifically identifying it as a drone is that we must consider the investigation results so far and conduct further investigations before making a judgment. It might not be a drone but a missile; various possibilities are open." Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, regarding the entity that launched the aerial vehicle that struck the NAMUHO, commented, "There are multiple possibilities among those who could have fired such a thing, just in Iran. It could also be a militia group." <<> Reporters: Seo Young-ji, Washington / Kim Won-chul yj@hani.co.kr (안 장관은 이날 워싱턴 주미 한국대사관에서 열린 특파원 간담회에서 전날 피트 헤그세스 미 국방장관과의 면담 내용을 설명하며 “우리 입장에서는 조기 전작권 환수에 추호도 흔들림이 없다. 헤그세스 장관은 조건에 기초한 전작권 전환에 전적으로 동의하고, 그에 맞춰서 조속히 전환되길 본인도 희망하고 있다고 말했다”고 전했다. 다만 그는 “미국 쪽에서 약간의 다른 생각을 가진 부분이 있다”고 덧붙였다. 우리 정부는 양국 정상의 임기가 끝나기 전인 2028년이나 그 이전까지 전작권 전환을 목표로 하지만, 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 전작권 전환 달성 목표 시기를 ‘2029년 1분기 이전’이라고 했다.)

item.title: After Seoul and Yeongnam, Jeonbuk also heads into unpredictable tight race… Tension rising in Democratic Party (서울·영남 이어 전북도 예측불허 ‘접전’…긴장감 도는 민주당)
item.description:
With 21 days left until the June 3 local elections, tension is mounting within the Democratic Party of Korea on the 13th. This comes as the race for regional government heads in the Yeongnam region becomes a close contest, and polls for the Seoul mayoral election show a narrowing gap. Additionally, even in the traditionally stronghold region of Jeonbuk, the gubernatorial race sees independent candidate Kim Gwan-young (who was expelled from the party) garnering significant support. <<> The races shifting from Democratic Party dominance to razor-thin within the margin of error are in the Yeongnam region. According to a telephone survey of 801 residents in Busan conducted by Gallup Korea on the 10th-11th on behalf of News 1, Democratic Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeon Jae-soo had a 43% approval rating, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon had 41%, a gap within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). In a hypothetical two-way race conducted by Gallup Korea for Segye Ilbo on April 9-10, the figures were 51% and 40%, respectively. <<> Daegu shows a similar trend. In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea on the 9th-10th for News 1, the gap between Democratic Party Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum (44%) and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho (41%) was just 3 percentage points, well within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points, telephone survey). <<> A survey on the Gyeongnam gubernatorial race conducted on the 11th-12th also showed Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo at 45% and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo at 38%, remaining within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points, telephone survey). <<> Tension is palpable within the party. <<> A multi-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said, "Even without this, the basic premise was that the Yeongnam elections would become an intense battle as time goes on due to conservative consolidation, but the atmosphere has clearly worsened since the proposal of the special counsel bill for the alleged manipulation case." He added, "With 20 days left, we are in a situation where we need to rally our votes enough to make up for the losses (conservative consolidation) caused by the special counsel bill." Another lawmaker from the Yeongnam region noted, "People Power Party banners demanding a special counsel are hung all over every neighborhood," and added, "Although discussions on the special counsel law were postponed until after the election, I believe the negative impact persists." <<> The Seoul mayoral election, a two-way race between Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-o and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon, is also intensifying. <<> In a survey conducted a month ago (by Segye Ilbo and Hankook Ilbo on April 10-11, telephone survey), Jeong had 52% and Oh had 37%, a double-digit gap (15 percentage points). However, in a survey released today (by News 1 and Gallup Korea, conducted on the 9th-10th, telephone survey), Jeong had 46% and Oh had 38%, reducing the gap to a single digit (8 percentage points). A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Overall, (Jeong Won-o's) ability to drive the agenda is declining," and added, "He is failing to seize the initiative and is getting bogged down in the real estate debates created by Oh." <<> The Jeonbuk gubernatorial election is emerging as a potential upset. In a suitability poll for Jeonbuk governor (conducted by News 1's Jeonbuk Bureau and JoWon C&I on the 9th-10th, automated response), independent candidate Kim Gwan-young recorded 43.2%, while Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek received 39.7%. <<> Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do, who visited Jeonbuk on the 11th, returned again just two days later on the 13th, stating, "Only the Democratic Party candidate can save Saemangeum," as he began to bolster support for his party's candidate Lee Won-taek. Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and Policy Committee Chairperson Han Jeong-ae also held a press conference that morning, unleashing a wave of pledges, including the proposal of the Mega Special Zone Act by the end of June and the introduction of climate insurance. <<> Reporters Jeong Hye-min and Kim Chae-un jhm@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거를 21일 앞둔 13일 더불어민주당에서 긴장감이 높아지고 있다. 영남권 광역단체장 선거가 혼전이고 서울시장 선거 역시 격차가 줄어드는 여론조사들이 나오면서다. 여기에 전통적 우세 지역인 전북지사 선거마저 당에서 제명된 김관영 전북지사가 만만찮은 지지율을 얻고 있다.)

item.title: ‘National Dividend’ Controversy and Unification Calculus… Variables Shaking the Local Elections [Gongdeok Pocha] (‘국민배당금’ 논란·단일화 셈법…지방선거 흔드는 변수들 [공덕포차])
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung personally posted on X (formerly Twitter) on the 13th to quell the controversy over the ‘national dividend.’ After an interpretation spread that this concept, initiated by Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, targeted ‘corporate excess profits,’ the President stepped in to clarify, saying, “It is a matter of how to distribute the excess tax revenue generated from the boom in semiconductors and AI.” (이재명 대통령이 13일 직접 X(옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 ‘국민배당금’ 논란 진화에 나섰습니다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 쏘아 올린 이 구상이 ‘기업의 초과이윤’을 겨냥한 것이라는 해석이 퍼지자, 대통령이 나서서 “반도체·AI 호황으로 국고에 더 들어오는 초과세수를 어떻게 나눌지의 문제”라고 못박은 겁니다.)

The catalyst was Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom’s proposal to return the excess tax revenue from the AI industry boom to the people. Abroad, this remark was interpreted as a signal to share the profits earned by AI companies with society, causing stock markets to waver. The shockwaves quickly spread to the political arena. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk escalated the offensive, calling it “something only a communist party would do,” while Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae indirectly expressed dissatisfaction, stating, “It seems there was no discussion with the party ahead of time.” (발단은 김용범 정책실장이 인공지능 산업 호황으로 발생한 초과 세수를 국민에게 돌려주자고 제안한 것이 시작이었습니다. 해외에서는 이 발언이 ‘인공지능 기업이 번 돈을 사회가 나눠 갖자’는 신호로 읽히면서 주식시장이 출렁였습니다. 파장은 곧바로 정치권으로 번졌습니다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 “공산당이나 하는 일 아니냐”며 공세 수위를 끌어올렸고, 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 “당과 어떤 대화는 없었던 것 같다”며 에둘러 불만을 내비쳤습니다.)

With the June 3 local elections approaching, whether opposition candidates will unite in competitive districts has emerged as a major variable. The elections include the Pyeongtaek-Byeol by-election, the Busan North Gap by-election, and the Ulsan mayoral election. Both the opposition camp and the broader conservative camp face complex calculations. First, in Pyeongtaek-Byeol, a ‘two-axis unification’ is being put to the test: an opposition alliance between Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Cho Kuk, and a conservative alliance between People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong and Freedom and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn. In Busan North Gap, the key is whether People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon can form a conservative alliance against Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo. In Ulsan, the biggest point of interest is whether Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon can join hands against incumbent People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-gyeom.
